min.description: Fixed value-axis minimum. Omit (along with `max`) to auto-scale to the data.

max.description: Fixed value-axis maximum. Omit (along with `min`) to auto-scale to the data.

horiz.description: Draws horizontal bars instead of vertical ones.

xlabels.description: Labels for each bar, used when the channel sends an array of numbers (one label per element) instead of a label→value object.
